name: face_top
title: Face top
description: Faces the stock top in passes along X from work X0 Y0 toward +X and +Y, at Z = -depth, then lifts to the clearance.

name: park
title: Park
description: Lifts Z to the top of travel - only ever up - then moves X and Y to the park position, both in machine coordinates.

why: a ; comment is always description, whatever its first word
text:
; CNC warm-up for the morning
(MACRO Warm)
o<warm> sub
o<warm> endsub
name: warm
title: Warm

why: a paren comment starting with an all-caps word is a header word, never description
text:
(MACRO Warm)
(CNC warm-up)
(spins the spindle up)
o<warm> sub
o<warm> endsub
name: warm
title: Warm

why: header words, then the description; spaces inside the comment trimmed
text:
(MACRO  Go home )
(UNITS mm)
(PARAM 1 x "X" length 0)
(   moves home   )
o<go_home> sub
o<go_home> endsub
name: go_home
title: Go home

text:
o<bare> sub
G0 X0
o<bare> endsub
name: bare

why: a comment after the sub is no description; the label is read lower-case, spaces removed
